extraction_notes: Target identity retained exactly from job metadata: AO3400, FOSAN, n-channel MOSFET.
The supplied PDF is branded ANHUI FOSAN SEMICONDUCTOR TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD. and identifies AO3400 as a 30 V N-channel enhancement-mode MOS field-effect transistor in SOT-23.
No revision identifier or revision date is stated in the supplied five-page PDF.

RDS(on) table values are transcribed as inclusive maximums: 27 mOhm at VGS = 10 V and ID = 5.8 A, 33 mOhm at VGS = 4.5 V and ID = 5 A, and 51 mOhm at VGS = 2.5 V and ID = 3 A; the table heading states TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.
Ciss, Coss, and Crss are typical values of 630 pF, 55 pF, and 71 pF at VGS = 0 V, VDS = 15 V, and f = 1 MHz, transcribed in SI units.
Output, transfer, on-resistance, and capacitance curve points are compact direct readings from the supplied typical plots on p. 3. No points were generated by interpolation.
The output-curve labels VGS = 2.5/3/4.5 V are grouped in Fig. 1 and do not individually identify the corresponding traces; those traces were not assigned to a single VGS value.

Additional tabulated fields not represented by the strict schema include BVDSS = 30 V, VGS = +/-12 V, continuous ID = 5.8 A at TA = 25 degC, pulsed IDM = 23 A, PD = 1.2 W at TA = 25 degC, RthetaJA = 104 degC/W, TJ/Tstg = -55 to 150 degC, IDSS max = 1 uA at VGS = 0 V and VDS = 30 V, IGSS max = +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-12 V and VDS = 0 V, Qg typ = 17 nC, Qgs typ = 2 nC, Qgd typ = 2 nC, and switching-time typical values; p. 1 and p. 2 citations.
